The '''''Kadnessi Family''''' was one of the ruling families of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==History==
The loyalty oath the [[Elder of Kadnessi]] had pledged to the [[Elder of Knylenn]] was dissolved around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] upon discovery of the latter's death. In an attempt to overturn the [[Inheritance Exemption]], [[Khoss of Knylenn]] reanimated the dead corpse of the Elder of Knylenn so that this and other loyalty oaths pledged to him were still valid. This attempt was quickly thwarted by [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]].
